pageDescription: Radio buttons let users choose exactly one option from a set. Design specs will align to FMS radio tokens.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: Each radio option includes a control, label, and optional helper text.

parts.label: Control
parts.description: Circular indicator showing unselected, hover, focus, and selected states.

parts.label: Label
parts.description: Describes the option; clicking the label selects the control.

parts.label: Group label (optional)
parts.description: Heading for the set of related radio options.

specification.title: Specification guidelines
specification.description: Control size and label spacing will be updated from Figma measurements.

types.title: Radio types
types.description: Preview placeholder controls until the radio canvas is built from Figma.

guidelines.title: Guideline
guidelines.description: Use radios when all options must be visible and only one selection is allowed.

rows: Use radios for 2–7 mutually exclusive options.
Use radios when multiple selections are allowed (use checkboxes).
Pre-select a sensible default when one option is recommended.
Force users to select without a clear default when all options are equal.

items.heading: Single choice
items.body: Present radios vertically for forms and filters where the user must pick one value.

items.heading: Segmented patterns
items.body: For compact layouts, consider button-style radio groups once documented in Figma.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
rows: Interactive radio group on design tab
